name: Flaming Sphere
material: Tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and powdered phosphorus
description: A 5-foot sphere of fire rolls on the ground. Creatures that end their turn next to it, or that it rams into, make a Dexterity save or take 2d6 fire damage. You can move it as a bonus action.
at_higher_levels: Damage rises by 1d6 per slot level above 2.
